import{useState,useEffect}from'react';export const useTheme=()=>{const[isDark,setIsDark]=useState(false);useEffect(()=>{// Only run on client side
const savedTheme=typeof window!=='undefined'?localStorage.getItem('theme'):null;const prefersDark=typeof window!=='undefined'?window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches:false;const initialTheme=savedTheme==='dark'||!savedTheme&&prefersDark;setIsDark(initialTheme);},[]);useEffect(()=>{if(typeof window!=='undefined'){localStorage.setItem('theme',isDark?'dark':'light');if(isDark){document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');}else{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');}}},[isDark]);const toggleTheme=()=>{setIsDark(prev=>!prev);};return{isDark,toggleTheme};};
